hookups.source: https://augresriverfrontcampground.com/ ('108 spacious campsites and two cozy cabins, 25 full hook-up (sewer, water & electric), 33 river site with water and electric and 50 off river sites with water and electric'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 108 sites: 25 full hookup, 33 riverside and 50 off-river with water and electric; 2 cabins. The city says 28 more lots and more cabins are coming. The reservation form takes rigs from under 20 ft to 40+ ft.

sites.source: https://augresriverfrontcampground.com/ (as for hookups; 'Coming soon with additional 28 lots and cabins') + https://augresriverfrontcampground.com/reservation-request/ (Size of Camper: 'Small (up to 20 ft)' ... 'Extra Large (40+ ft)'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://augresriverfrontcampground.com/amenities/ ('modern restroom and shower facilities', 'Small store inside park office for ice, drinks, wood, snacks and more!'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Second weekend of April through the second weekend of October.

season.source: https://augresriverfrontcampground.com/reservation-request/ ('Campsites will be available for reservations after January 2nd for the current year of the 2nd weekend of April though the 2nd weekend of October'), read 2026-10-22; the derived 04-15 / 10-15 fall outside those weekends and are cleared

values.note: No self-service online booking: send the reservation request form or call (989) 876-8310 and staff assign the site. Bookings for the season open after January 2.

booking.source: https://augresriverfrontcampground.com/ ('At this time, we handle all bookings in-house'; 'To book or to contact us today, call (989) 876-8310') + https://augresriverfrontcampground.com/reservation-request/ ('While we don't currently offer self-service online booking, our reservations team personally manages each request'), read 2026-10-22

note: City of Au Gres municipal campground, 522 Park St, on the Au Gres River near Saginaw Bay; city-run since the 1960s. Lighted riverfront walkway with a footbridge into town, kayak rentals at the office, boat launch. Distinct from Arenac County's separate Point Au Gres Park. --Claude
summary: The campground's own site (augresriverfrontcampground.com, (c) 2025): 108 sites (count 109 -> 108: 25 full hookup, 33 river and 50 off-river W/E) + 2 cabins; water/sewer confirmed (amperage not stated); showers, office store; season 2nd weekend of April - 2nd weekend of October (derived 04-15/10-15 cleared, span in season.note); booked by request form or phone, no online booking. No rate published anywhere by the city (fees stay empty).
